testing.e2ePolicy: Never run E2E tests. The user runs them manually.

extra.plannerTopics: - edge cases and concurrency (transactions, retries, races).
extra.implementerRules: - Match the conventions of neighboring files. Do not add a new library or pattern without an ADR.
extra.reviewerChecks: - Tests exist for new code and assert the behavior, not the implementation.

agents.toolRules: - Before a broad grep or a whole-file read, use the project's code index or code-search tool when one is set up.
